text: South Korea's Kospi rose about 9.6% after falling 12% the prior session. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics gained over 10% and 11%. The Kosdaq closed 14.1% higher. The Korea Exchange temporarily halted trading on both indexes during the upward surge.

meta.note: Rapid reversal within 24 hours; logged as separate atomic market configuration.

text: Berkshire Hathaway disclosed the resumption of buybacks of Class A and Class B shares. CEO Greg Abel separately purchased $15 million of Berkshire stock. The repurchase policy allows buybacks when leadership assesses shares to be below intrinsic value.

meta.note: Corporate repurchase and executive purchase occur within same governance disclosure window.

text: Twenty-four state attorneys general led by New York prepared a lawsuit in the Court of International Trade seeking to block federal tariffs imposed under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974. The action follows a Supreme Court ruling invalidating earlier tariffs implemented under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

meta.note: Legal action not yet filed at timestamp but publicly confirmed as imminent litigation step.
